# Portable runtime qualification inputs

These five immutable test inputs retain the original accepted registration inventory and historical source-byte checks. They are copied byte-for-byte from recorded Git blobs, so ordinary CI does not depend on the private `_goals` tree. Historical TypeScript is data (`.ts.txt`), never imported or executed. All runtime tests still use current maintained backend modules.

The original goal evidence remains untouched. Availability of these five blobs does not establish recovery of other C7 inputs or historical filesystem custody. See `provenance.json` for the exact source commit, blobs and byte hashes.
